item.title: US floated Ukraine ceding Donbas for NATO membership, Zelensky says
item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said on Friday that United States negotiators raised the idea of Ukraine withdrawing its remaining forces from the eastern Donbas region in exchange for NATO membership, marking the first time the proposal had been put forward. item.title: FAA ground stop disrupts flights; officials blame aging equipment, not cyberattack
item.description: A total nationwide ground stop is an exceptionally rare aviation event — only the second since 9/11 — and Friday's disruption stemmed not from an external attack but from a communications-system failure that officials tied to the FAA's long-flagged aging infrastructure, including overloaded…

item.title: US shifts to economic pressure as Iran war stalemate continues; Iran claims strike on US radar in Bahrain
item.description: The United States is pivoting to economic pressure on Iran as the war that began on February 28 remains at a stalemate, with President Donald Trump sidelining Vice President JD Vance from the Iran file and declaring a deal is no longer a priority. item.title: Warsh Plan to Remake Fed: Fewer Rate Votes, More Deliberation; 2027 Calendar Confirmed
item.description: The Federal Reserve on Thursday released its 2027 meeting schedule, confirming that the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) will hold eight meetings but vote on interest rates at only seven of them. item.title: Microsoft outage escalates into global cloud crisis, experts say worse than CrowdStrike
item.description: A widespread outage that began midday Thursday has disrupted Microsoft 365 services globally, affecting email, cloud storage, AI tools, and security software for hundreds of millions of users.
